name: smwmusic-touhou-hisouten-scarlet-weather-rhapsody-drunk-as-i-like-remix-ii
title: Touhou Hisouten ~ Scarlet Weather Rhapsody - Drunk As I Like (Remix II)
description:
The song that plays in the cutscene before you fight Suika Ibuki, but most of you probably know it from the Demoman YTPMV (Also known as "Drunk As I Like") or the Silva-rip of "Mario Party - Play A Mini-game! (Drunk Mix)." Not exactly 1:1 with the original, but more of a remix (a sampled one if you may), with some things being the same as before, but other things not so much.

It could fit small cutscenes, credits, title screens, or even some calm levels.

Note: In the txt file, there are five customizable options that allow you to change the pitch of the song to either the b minor (Default), c minor, d minor (Original), c# minor, and a# minor. If you don't know what those mean, mess with the options and you'll get it.

Also, it's not compatible with Thunder/Blargg SFX or the Bonus End SFX. There's a txt file with the sample group in which you'll have to move into your sample groups txt file.
